title: Waves
players: 3 teams; 2–3 attackers versus 1 defender at a time (source)
equipment: Proposed: balls, goals, cones, three colours of pinnies.
setup: Two fields back-to-back: source suggests 10–15 yard midfield sections, 5–8 yard final sections, 15–20 yard width.
instructions: Two teams alternate attacks; third defends. Coach serves ball.
On goal, ball out or foul, defender moves to next field as coach serves other attack.
Change defenders every 3–4 turns; defending teams every 5–6 minutes.
support: Proposed option: Allow recovery before the defender’s next turn.
challenge: Proposed option: Change to 2v2 or 3v2 if suitable (source progression).
observe: Can defender reorient before next attack?
